lede: This week: Florence Pugh's acclaimed East of Eden lands on Netflix, Evil Dead Burn goes gory on HBO Max, The Apothecary Diaries returns, and Sacrifice, Animals and Blade Runner 2099 are on the calendar.

shortlist.title: East of Eden
shortlist.meta: Adaptation of John Steinbeck's novel; with Florence Pugh as Cathy Ames. 7-episode limited series.
shortlist.blurb: Netflix's lavish Steinbeck adaptation is winning critics over, with Pugh's cunning, captivating Cathy Ames the clear centerpiece. It's Pugh's third-best-reviewed TV series.

shortlist.title: Evil Dead Burn
shortlist.meta: Dir. Sébastien Vaniček (Infested). Latest Evil Dead franchise entry.
shortlist.blurb: The Infested director goes all-out with relentless, vicious gore in the franchise's most brutal chapter yet. Some fans miss the humor, but it's a strong October horror pick.

shortlist.title: The Apothecary Diaries Season 3
shortlist.meta: Anime adaptation; Crunchyroll fall 2026 simulcast, new episodes weekly.
shortlist.blurb: The sharp-minded pharmacist returns after the rebellion, pulled into a new mystery involving a rumored immortal maiden and a looming famine. One of anime's best period mystery series is back.

shortlist.title: Physical 100: Italy
shortlist.meta: Netflix reality competition, Physical: 100 franchise; Italian edition, episodes releasing in batches.
shortlist.blurb: One hundred Italian athletes face brutal physical challenges in the latest Physical: 100 spin-off. A fresh episode dropped Oct 2, so it's easy to catch up.

movies.title: Schumacher '94
movies.blurb: Documentary on the 1994 Formula 1 season that launched Michael Schumacher's legendary career.

tv.title: The Sisters Grimm
tv.blurb: Season 2 of the Apple TV series arrives.

tv.title: Adventure Time: Side Quests
tv.blurb: The Adventure Time spin-off series returns for another season on Disney+ and Hulu.

tv.title: Tyler Perry's Doing Life
tv.blurb: A gritty urban drama about a single mother fighting for survival who forms an unexpected bond with a reformed ex-con.

anime.title: Black Clover Season 2
anime.blurb: Asta and the Magic Knights raid the Spade Kingdom to rescue their captains from the Dark Triad.

anime.title: Ranma1/2 Season 3
anime.blurb: Netflix's remake of the classic martial-arts romcom continues.

anime.title: Magical Explorer
anime.blurb: New fall 2026 fantasy series arriving on Crunchyroll.

anime.title: A Tale of the Secret Saint
anime.blurb: New fall 2026 fantasy series premiering on Crunchyroll.

catalog.title: Terror in Resonance
catalog.blurb: Shinichiro Watanabe's riveting anime thriller joins the Criterion Channel's October lineup.

catalog.title: The Wailing
catalog.blurb: Na Hong-jin's Korean possession horror, part of Criterion's Possessions collection.

catalog.title: The Vanishing
catalog.blurb: George Sluizer's chilling thriller, part of Criterion's Highway Horror collection.

catalog.title: Duel
catalog.blurb: Spielberg's early highway thriller in Criterion's Highway Horror series.

catalog.title: La cérémonie
catalog.blurb: Claude Chabrol's domestic thriller in Criterion's Unwelcome Guests collection.

catalog.title: The Bird with the Crystal Plumage
catalog.blurb: Dario Argento's giallo debut, part of Criterion's Argento retrospective.

announced.title: Sacrifice
announced.blurb: Netflix set an Oct 16 date for Romain Gavras' satire thriller with Chris Evans and Anya Taylor-Joy, about a movie star taken hostage by a volcanic doomsday cult.

announced.title: Animals
announced.blurb: Netflix confirmed Oct 9 for Ben Affleck's directed and starring kidnapping thriller.

announced.title: Below
announced.blurb: Netflix's six-episode sea-creature horror limited series with Josh Hartnett and Charlie Heaton premieres Oct 8.

announced.title: VisionQuest
announced.blurb: Disney+ drops the first two episodes of the Paul Bettany Vision series from Terry Matalas on Oct 14.

announced.title: Dead-End Job
announced.blurb: Netflix confirmed Oct 30 for the K-drama starring Lee Jae-wook as a man taking oddly lucrative part-time jobs.

announced.title: Black Doves Season 2
announced.blurb: Netflix released the trailer and Nov 5 date for all six episodes, with Keira Knightley and Ben Whishaw returning.

announced.title: The Lord of the Rings: The Rings of Power Season 3
announced.blurb: Prime Video sets Nov 11 for four episodes, with the rest following Nov 18 and Nov 25.

announced.title: Blade Runner 2099
announced.blurb: All eight episodes of the Michelle Yeoh and Hunter Schafer sequel series arrive Nov 25 on Prime Video.

announced.title: Carrie
announced.blurb: Mike Flanagan's Stephen King adaptation drops all eight episodes Oct 7 on Prime Video, with early reviews around 85% on Rotten Tomatoes.
